stats.metric: WPA = win rate minus average pre-game win probability, in percentage points
stats.pickCountsNote: Keystone pick counts are across all secondary trees. Coachless shows no win rate or pre-game WP on the runes page, only WPA and picks.

wiki.note: Ranged values (Kog'Maw is ranged). Level ranges are 1 to 18.

keystones.name: First Strike
keystones.wiki: Hit a champion first: 3s of 7% bonus true damage to champions, and 35% of that bonus damage back as gold. 25 to 15s cooldown; lost if they hit you first.

keystones.name: Lethal Tempo
keystones.wiki: Each attack on a champion: +4.8% attack speed for 6s, up to 6 stacks (28.8%). At 6 stacks attacks add 6 to 21.7 adaptive damage, +1% per 1% bonus attack speed.

keystones.name: Arcane Comet
keystones.wiki: Ability damage to a champion drops a comet: 15 to 110 (+10% bonus AD, +5% AP), doubled at max travel distance.

keystones.name: Press the Attack
keystones.wiki: 3 attacks on one champion within 4s: 40 to 174 adaptive damage, then +8% damage to champions until 5s after leaving combat.

keystones.name: Stormraider's Surge
keystones.wiki: Deal 25% of a champion's max health within 3s: +36% move speed and 50% slow resist for 4s. 20 to 8.8s cooldown.
